title: Qwen2.5-0.5B echoes a Ukrainian question forever under greedy decoding; sampling escapes 6/6
user_report: I asked Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct a simple question in Ukrainian and it just repeats my question back, over and over, until it runs out of tokens. I guess this model can't do Ukrainian. Should I fine-tune it on Ukrainian data?
